result.reason: Section 2.1 tracks the fallback: any commitment is confined to the current 12-month term, may be reduced on 30 days’ notice, and uses a unit-rate true-up rather than a penalty; other fees remain usage- or order-based. The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated terms. However, Section 12.3 still states that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, creating an internal inconsistency with Section 2.1 that should be conformed or clarified.
